title: Client document, major 1
description: What GET /client answers: the client the presented token belongs to, and the walls assigned to it, each with the name of the client's output it is shown on. A client polls it about every 30 seconds with If-None-Match and starts or stops a worker per wall from it. Only walls assigned to this client are listed. Additive keys are allowed. Semantics are in .prawduct/artifacts/player-contract.md § Transport and clients.md.

name.description: The curator's name for this client.

walls.description: Every wall assigned to this client, in the order the server lists walls. Empty is an ordinary state: a client nobody has given a wall to yet.

wall_id.description: The id the per-wall routes take.

output.description: The name of the client's output this wall is shown on, as the client reported it in its heartbeat (hdmi-a-1, frame). The server holds only the name.
